description: This source file defines enums, structs, and functions related to probing and handling the remote gateway connection, including authentication issues, validation, and asynchronous connectivity checks for the OpenClaw remote gateway.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously probes the remote gateway to check its status, including network validation, SSH checks, and health snapshot, and returns a result indicating connection status or specific issues.

methods.name: isValidWsUrl
methods.description: Checks whether a given WebSocket URL is valid based on the normalized URL.

methods.name: sshCheckCommand
methods.description: Constructs an SSH command for checking SSH connectivity to a target with a specific identity.

methods.name: formatSSHFailure
methods.description: Formats an error message based on the SSH command response, especially handling host key verification failures.
